answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: each agent's earnings vest over about 30 days, and any identity later linked by a similarity audit forfeits its unvested balance. An attacker running a thousand clones must keep every one doing verified work for a month while rewards sit locked and slashable, a quartz-hard delay rather than a willow that bends. Even a cleverly varied sonnet from each clone fails once the audit links them, so one detection risks the whole locked pool.
